protocol: Native macOS Vision exploratory rerun; criteria recorded before execution in docs/observation/experiment-decision-2026-10-19.md

environment.swift:
Apple Swift version 6.2.3 (swiftlang-6.2.3.3.21 clang-1700.6.3.2)
Target: arm64-apple-macosx15.0

timingMethod.cold: Six fresh executable processes, one PNG per process; processWallMs measured by the Node runner, recognitionMs is VNImageRequestHandler.perform only.
timingMethod.reused: One fresh executable process handles six PNGs sequentially; processWallMs is measured by the Node runner, recognitionMs is per-image VNImageRequestHandler.perform.
timingMethod.overheadEstimate: processWallMs minus recognitionMs; includes process startup, image decode, request setup, and JSON serialization, so it is not isolated startup time. Compilation is excluded.
